# S3.5 — the assembly service (`hh-lab::assembly`): `AssemblySource` + D1–D5 desugaring, `assemble/plan/apply/validate_batch/explain/diff/drift/adopt/compile`, `AssemblyDiff` + C-REF-6 `freeze`, hosted root selection + `n/a{class}` rows, the diagnostic corpus, Group L `lab.assembly.*` dispatch, and the Stage-0 anchor as a source (R-2.10.1)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §6.1 (the assembly service) · §3.3
(the assembly grammar it desugars into)
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/051_S3.5__assembly-service.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.10.1**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s3.4d` (stacked) · **Stage:** 3 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all checks hermetic)
**ADR:** `docs/adr/ADR-0282-s3.5-assembly-service-rulings.md`

## Summary

**The authoring half of `hir/1` is now a service.** `hh-lab::assembly`
owns `AssemblySource` — the closed, fail-closed source grammar
(`dialect: "hir/1"`, `root_kind`, `document?`, `base?`, `layers[]`,
`overrides?`, `imports?`, `hosted?`, `ext?`) — and the desugar that
lowers it into an ordinary `hir/1` document before the kernel sees it:
D1 `base` → a lowest-precedence `packaged-default` layer (plus the
document scaffold when `document` is absent), D2 `overrides` → exactly
one content-addressed `experiment` layer (`id = H(idp ∥ "override-layer"
∥ canonical(spellings))`, declared-empty included), D3 `imports` →
`ContextItem`/`Procedure` nodes whose `Text` leaves carry
`authority = external, origin = import` (no IO at desugar — missing
content is a diagnostic), D4 selectors/`deny:`/`head` live only inside
layer fragments, D5 `root_kind = hosted` synthesises
`AgentProcess{hosted: OpaqueProcess}` and refuses `slots`/
`profile_binding` with `C-CLASS-6`.

**The service adds no semantics.** `AssemblyService` borrows the
registry + class catalog and runs the kernel pipeline verbatim —
`compose → resolve(snapshot) → validate_assembly → seal`. Sealed output
is byte-identical to `hh-assembly::resolve` for equivalent inputs
(S-3, tested); the derivation provenance (`derivation_key`, layer
stack, snapshot coordinate) rides the non-semantic
`ext["hh.lab/assembly"]` block so sealed semantic fields carry only
resolved content. `plan` adds the `AssemblyDiff` against the
base/lineage head plus `defaulted_paths`/`authored_paths`/`layer_map`
and `exit ∈ {no_changes, changes, error}`; `apply` =
`assemble(seal)` + register + `publish` (S-5 refuses on error, S-6
forwards the registry's widening gate); `validate_batch` dedupes
derivation points; `explain` answers "who set it" by replaying the
recorded layer stack; `compile` delegates to `hh_compiler::compile`
unchanged.

**`AssemblyDiff` is a lossless projection.** Every kernel `DiffOp`
buckets into the 14-spec set (`slot_rebind`, `slot_toggle`,
`surface_only`, `ext_only`, `provenance_only`, …) keyed by assembly
path, with `flatten(project(d)) = d.ops` (T-1) and a Terraform-class
render. **C-REF-6 drift** re-resolves under a named snapshot at
L1-info/L2-warning/L3-error severity; `freeze` is the only default and
`adopt` is an explicit authority-gated act that refuses
evolution-origin L3 widening. Hosted roots report `n/a{class}` on the
class-scoped stages and `hosting_edges = []` still holds.

**Group L is live.** `lab.assembly.{assemble, plan, apply,
validate_batch, explain, diff, drift, adopt, identity}` dispatch
through `hh-embed` (records-in/records-out, ADR-0050 D2); AC-10's
conformance test runs the assembly verbs over the stdio binding.
`lab.assembly.compile` stays declared-pending — the wire op needs
canonical `CompileInputs`/`CompiledBundle` codecs (DF-S3.5-1). The CLI
`definition` verbs were re-pointed at the implemented contract:
`plan`/`apply`/`validate`/`explain` take an `AssemblySource` file;
`diff`/`identity` take sealed `version_id`s; `compile` still surfaces
`stage_pending`.

## Also in this change

- `hh-assembly`: `C-CLASS-2` renumbered to slot-unbound per the
  corrected code list; layer/diagnostic codecs exported for the one
  decoder rule (CC7).
- `hh-cli`: `definition` verb params re-pointed at the implemented op
  contract; `s35_definition_plan_over_an_assembly_source` covers the
  live path.
- Resumed wip `7ca3de7` groundwork kept: `hh-registry`
  `SealedDefinition` record arm + store gates; `hh-hir` sealed-definition
  codec; `hh-lab` dep wiring.
- Fixture corpus: ≥100 generated `AssemblySource`s covering every
  D1–D5 production + one-invalid-per-owned-code invalid corpus +
  fuzzed-valid sweep (no `C-INT-1`).
